events.title: Full Demo Playthrough by the Developer
events.summary: Watch the developer play through the entire demo from start to finish.This video presents the complete demo experience, including combat, story progression, unit controls, and major gameplay systems.This is a pre-recorded broadcast and will repeat throughout the scheduled broadcast period.

events.title: Hello. This is Leon, the solo developer of “Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592.”
events.summary: Here’s what’s new in this demo update:Reworked the elevation and rock layout of the demo battle maps. Taking the high ground matters more now.Bows, guns and spells aimed downward from high ground no longer have a height limit. In exchange, accuracy drops a little when the height gap is large.Enemy archers and gunners now take the highest positions first.Improved story delivery. Revised the on-map dialogue.Fixed some English dialogue.Thank you for playing my game.
